eng.verrou.type: Only text, announcement and voice channels can be locked.
eng.verrou.droits_membre: You need the "Manage Channels" and "Manage Permissions" permissions in {salon}.
eng.verrou.droits_bot: I need the following in {salon}: View Channel, Manage Channels, Manage Permissions, Send Messages (including in threads), Create Threads and Add Reactions.
eng.lock.occupe: Another command is already changing {salon}, try again in a moment.
eng.lock.note: ⚠️ These roles have their own permission in the channel and can still write: {roles}
eng.lock.annonce: 🔒 Channel locked by the moderation. Reason: ***{raison}***
eng.unlock.ok: 🔓 {salon} is unlocked (@everyone permissions restored to what they were before /lock).
eng.slowmode.type: Slowmode does not apply to this type of channel.
eng.slowmode.court: Duration too short: 1 second minimum (or `0` to disable).
eng.slowmode.perm_membre: You don't have permission to manage {salon}!
eng.slowmode.perm_bot: I don't have permission to manage {salon}!
eng.automod.mots_vides: Give the words in `valeur`, separated by commas (e.g. `word1, word2, *partial*`).
eng.automod.mot_long: Each word must be 60 characters at most.
eng.automod.mentions_valeur: Give in `valeur` the maximum number of mentions per message (1 to 50).
eng.automod.perm_bot: I need the "Manage Server" permission to manage AutoMod.
eng.automod.liste_pied: -# Administrators and members with "Manage Server" are never blocked by AutoMod: test with an account without these permissions.
eng.automod.aucune: No AutoMod rule created by the bot.
eng.automod.supprimer_id: Give in `valeur` the ID of a rule created by the bot (shown by the "Voir les règles du bot" action).
eng.automod.refuse: Discord refused the rule: limit reached (6 keyword rules, 1 anti-spam and 1 anti-mentions per server) or invalid setting.
eng.automod.alertes_aucune: (Set up /setlogs then run the command again to receive alerts.)
eng.refus.gere: This role is managed by an integration (bot, boost…).
eng.refus.dangereux: The role {role} has moderation or administration permissions: it cannot be handed out with a button.
eng.refus.dangereux_salon: The role {role} has moderation permissions in {salon}: it cannot be handed out with a button.
eng.refus.au_dessus: The role {role} is above my highest role: I cannot give it.
eng.refus.configurateur: You can only offer a role lower than your highest role.
eng.panneau.description: Click a button to take or remove the role.
eng.panneau.unique: Only one role from this panel at a time.
eng.panneau.vide: No role yet. A moderator can add some with `/roles action:Ajouter`.
eng.roles.aucun: No panel. Example: `/roles action:Créer texte:Choose your notifications`
eng.roles.cree: Panel created in {salon} (ID `{id}`). Add roles with `/roles action:Ajouter panneau:{id} role:@role`.
eng.roles.introuvable: Panel not found: give the message ID (see `/roles action:Voir`).
eng.roles.pas_sur_panneau: This role is not on this panel.
eng.roles.message_supprime: The panel message was deleted: panel forgotten. Create a new one.
eng.giveaway.tirage_impossible: The draw could not be done right now (already in progress or server unavailable). Try again in a moment.
eng.giveaway.relance_seulement_termine: Only an ended giveaway can be rerolled.
eng.giveaway.relance_impossible: New draw impossible for now, try again in a moment.
eng.giveaway.relance_vide: No participant left: nothing was changed.
eng.sondage.min_choix: You need at least 2 different choices, separated by `;`.
eng.sondage.choix_long: Each choice can be {max} characters at most.
eng.sondage.salon_bot: I cannot post a poll in {salon} (I need Send Messages and Create Polls).
eng.sondage.salon_membre: You cannot post a poll in {salon}.
eng.annonce.programmee:
Announcement #{id} scheduled {date} ({relatif}) in {salon}.
-# It will only be sent if you still have permission to write in this channel at that time. No mention (@everyone, roles) will be active in it.
eng.bienvenue.test_salon: I cannot write in the configured channel.
eng.annonce.prevue:
Announcement #{id} scheduled for {date} ({relatif}) in {salon}.
-# It will only be sent if you can still write in this channel at that time. No mention (@everyone, roles) will be active.
